g.text: Bound once, when the buffer is attached

text.tspan: · change what the view asks for
· the whole page is drawn again
· move the active cell, or the selection head
· extmarks over the text already there
· open a float, leaving the table alone
· read the values through xan, write the registers
· every key and the action it names
